name: pointlesh
description: Composable point-and-click adventure tooling for TypeScript games.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace pointlesh-forest-demo
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --test packages/*/test/*.test.mjs demos/forest/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace pointlesh-forest-demo
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && npm run dev:server --workspace pointlesh-forest-demo
